payload.title: Hunting for solar-related cyclicities over the Holocene
payload.description: This notebook explores the presence of solar-related cyclicities in Holocene paleoclimate records using spectral analysis. It retrieves temperature data from the Temperature 12k Database in LiPD format via SPARQL queries. The data is processed using the Pyleoclim library to perform spectral analysis and identify significant periodicities in the 800-3000 year range. The analysis reveals multiple spectral peaks, but no significant clustering by geography or archive type.
